Class LaminaMetrics

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.lamina.LaminaMetrics
public class LaminaMetrics extends Object
The LaminaMetrics type counts submits, completions, and failures for Lamina. Collection is off unless the constructor is given true. The counts are written only to the program log. The type does not send the counts to OpenTelemetry. OpenTelemetry is an external metrics system, and this type does not call it.

  • Constructor Details

    • LaminaMetrics

      public LaminaMetrics(boolean enabled)
      The constructor stores whether counting is on and starts each counter at zero. If enabled is false, recordSubmit(), recordComplete(), and recordFail() do nothing.
      Parameters:
      enabled - true when the counters should move, or false when every record call does nothing.

  • Method Details

    • isEnabled

      public boolean isEnabled()
      The isEnabled method reports whether counting is on.
      Returns:
      true when record calls change the counters, or false when they do nothing.

    • recordSubmit

      public void recordSubmit()
      The recordSubmit method counts one submitted task. If counting is off, the method returns without changing the counter. If counting is on, the submit counter increases by one. The new submit count is written to the debug log as lamina submit count= followed by that number.

    • recordComplete

      public void recordComplete()
      The recordComplete method counts one task that finished without throwing. If counting is off, the method returns without changing the counter. If counting is on, the complete counter increases by one. The method does not write a log line.

    • recordFail

      public void recordFail()
      The recordFail method counts one task that threw RuntimeException. If counting is off, the method returns without changing the counter. If counting is on, the fail counter increases by one. The new fail count is written to the debug log as lamina fail count= followed by that number.
